messages:
Alex: Quick design review on the compact credential modal after a usability pass. Found a few copy, focus order, and a11y nits. Posting consolidated notes + proposed small fixes.

Priya: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/compact-cred-modal (check frames 4-6). Top issues: CTA wording is confusing, warning placement is low-visibility, and keyboard focus ring missing on several controls. :thinking_face:

Jamie: Permission selector defaulting to `Project:write` is worrying. Recommend defaulting to least-privilege (`Project:read`) and adding a single-line helper beneath the selector: "Least privilege reduces blast radius."

Sam: Users thought "Create & Download" meant the file would auto-download. Let's avoid surprising behavior: primary = "Create key" (creates + shows secret), secondary = "Download" (explicit). Or open a small confirmation drawer with a clear download CTA.

Maria: Security reviewers flagged the empty-state illustration as too casual for secrets. Suggest swapping to a neutral icon and adding a one-line policy hint: "Rotate keys regularly; keys are soft-deleted for 14 days."

DesignBot: Auto-a11y scan: warning banner text contrast 3.5:1 (fails AA small). Also secret reveal lacks `aria-live` so screen reader users won't be notified.

Alex: Microcopy proposal: primary CTA "Create key"; success toast "Key created — copy and store it now" with inline `Download` button. Under permissions: "This key grants access to your project resources. Choose the minimum scope needed."

Priya: Found a tab-order regress: after tabbing out of the permissions dropdown focus jumps to the footer dismiss button before the secret visibility toggle. Fix order to: permissions -> secret visibility toggle -> footer actions. Add visible keyboard focus: `outline: 2px solid var(--focus)` and ensure focus styles are non-reliant on color alone.

Jamie: Rotate modal language is ambiguous about revocation timing. Update body to: "A new key will be created and the previous key is revoked immediately. You have 14 days to recover the previous key via soft-delete." Link to docs: /docs/keys#rotation-rollback.

Sam: For undo behavior, include an undo action in the toast and keep it actionable for 14 seconds. Example for engineers: ```json
{
  "toast": "Key rotated",
  "actions": [{"label": "Undo", "id": "undo-rotate"}],
  "ttl_ms": 14000
}
```

Maria: Move the red high-risk warning above the permissions selector so it's visible before selection. Add a small warning header: "⚠️ High risk: sensitive scope" and a one-liner explaining possible impacts.

Alex: a11y nit: add `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` to the secret container so screen readers announce the revealed secret. Also ensure the reveal button has `aria-expanded` toggled.

Priya: I'll update Figma with the permission helper, the reordered tab flow, and focus styles by EOD.

Jamie: I'll update rotate modal copy and draft the docs blurb for soft-delete and rollback.

Sam: I'll change the component to split create vs download and wire the undo toast.

Maria: I'll replace the empty-state art with a neutral illustration and add the rotation best-practices line.

Alex: Action items: Priya (Figma + focus order), Jamie (rotate copy + docs), Sam (component + toast), Maria (empty state + illustration). I'll open an accessibility bug linking the failed scan. :thumbsup:

DesignBot: Ticket created: PROD-5872 — "Compact credential modal: contrast, aria-live, focus order".

Alex: Great work. If any of the changes block dev, ping me and we can prioritize in the next sprint.
